channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: A new roadmap outlining seven phases for the upcoming version was documented. The backup system was updated to support a tiered archive and light node model. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: An AI component removed an outdated submodule and updated its documentation. The network storage system was improved to better track cold‑storage gaps and retain important markers. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: Investor tools received new lockout scenarios, improved calculations, and additional tests. The developer SDK added a function to retrieve payout addresses and refined its build process. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: The network milestone audit was completed and related documentation was archived. The wallet now reports the number of processed jobs, and the SDK added support for idempotency keys. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 10 November
item.description: The API scaffolding introduced service registration and rotating refresh tokens, and added password hashing and email indexing for security. The investor dashboard received design updates to meet accessibility contrast standards. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, gnus-dashboard.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 9 November
item.description: Password handling was improved to store hashes and index emails, and related tests were added. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding.
